basis: renders <header>/<aside> landmarks in a grid shell — the shell asserts no role of its own.

responsive.basis: the sidebar+grid row is flex-wrap with min-width: 50% on the grid area; the tile grid is repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, minTileWidth), 1fr)); gutters step px-4 sm:px-6 3xl:px-8; the aside slot is hidden w-full 2xl:block — visible only past 2xl.
